_comment: Captured from Discord web client in Chrome 155 / Windows on 2026-10-23. Values marked <runtime> must be generated per launch, never hardcoded.

headers.User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

superProperties._comment: Serialize in exactly this key order, compact JSON, then base64 -> X-Super-Properties header. Also send as 'properties' in the gateway IDENTIFY payload.
superProperties.browser_user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
superProperties.client_launch_id: <runtime: new random UUID v4 per app launch>
superProperties.launch_signature: <runtime: new random UUID v4 per app launch>

buildNumber._comment: client_build_number goes stale weekly. Refresh at startup by scanning discord.com/app's script bundles for build_number; fall back to the value above.
